summary: Iteration 26: tested public contact form (backend + UI), site settings address/website, client logo embedded in xlsx exports (cycles, usage range, history) incl. Marco-Polo fallback, monthly report send, login/welcome logo regression. Backend 16/16 pytest passed; frontend flows all passed on mobile 390px.

minor.issue: Rate limit keyed on first X-Forwarded-For entry which the client can spoof (sending a random XFF bypasses the 3/IP/h limit); only the global 30/h cap remains as protection. Consider using the last/ingress-appended XFF entry.

issues: 2-column grid truncates email/website/address input values (e.g. 'biuro@marcopolo-w', 'ul. Przykładowa 1') – consider 1 column on mobile, at least for address/website
Helper text still says 'Telefon i e-mail widoczne na stronie głównej' though website and address are also shown now

action_items: (Optional) single-column layout for site-card inputs on mobile and update helper text
critical_code_review_comments: public_contact inserts the rate-limit record before sending, so failed (503) sends also consume quota – acceptable anti-spam behaviour, just note it
server.py is ~1790 lines – should be split into routers (site/contact, reports/xlsx, cycles)
